title: New York Knicks Championship Parade 2026: How to Watch the Citywide Celebration Live Online
summary: New York City celebrates the Knicks with a ticker-tape parade in the "Canyon of Heroes" on Thursday (June 18) — watch without cable for free.
contentText:

After a 53-year drought, the New York Knicks won the 2026 NBA Finals defeating the San Antonio Spurs in Game 5, with Jalen Brunson named NBA Finals MVP. The feelings of excitement and joy are felt throughout New York City, especially for the first-ever championship parade for the team (there were no parades in 1970 or 1973).

On Thursday (June 18), the New York Knicks ticker-tape parade takes place on Lower Manhattan, as it travels north on Broadway through the “Canyon of Heroes.” It ends at New York City Hall with a ceremony, in which the team receives the keys to the city from Mayor Zohran Mamdani.

Watch 2026 NY Knicks Championship Parade with DirectV

- Date: Thursday (June 18) with a start time of 10 a.m. ET/7 a.m. PT

- Broadcast Channels: NBC 4 New York, FOX 5 NY, ABC7NY, CBS 2 New York

- Streaming: DirecTV , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , ExpressVPN

It’s likely there may be a number of other celebrities and famous recording artists in attendance during the championship parade, such as NY Knicks fans Spike Lee, Timothée Chalamet , 50 Cent, Fat Joe, Ben Stiller, Busta Rhymes, Alicia Keys, Tracy Morgan, Ice Spice, Cardi B, Michael J. Fox, Mariska Hargitay, Anne Hathaway and others. Who knows? Maybe even Haim and Taylor Swift might make an appearance for the parade.

When Does 2026 NY Knicks Championship Parade Start ?

The NY Knicks parade starts at 10 a.m. ET/7 a.m. PT and airs across local New York channels, including NBC 4 New York, FOX 5 NY, ABC7NY and CBS 2 New York. TV coverage begins at 9 a.m. ET/6 a.m. PT.
